Paragraph: Therefore, one who has renounced the fruits of his action, whose doubts are destroyed by transcendental knowledge, and who is situated firmly in the self, is not bound by works, O conqueror of riches.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Fear of being trapped by responsibilities and performance anxiety.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna states: 'Therefore, one who has renounced the fruits of his action, whose doubts are destroyed by transcendental knowledge, and who is situated firmly in the self, is not bound by works, O conqueror of riches.'
Outcome/Resolution: Renouncing outcome-attachment and dispelling doubt through knowledge allows one to act decisively without bondage.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Unshakable Certainty: Eliminating anxiety by resolving doubts through validated wisdom
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Detached Action: Engaging in work wholeheartedly while remaining unattached to results
Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Autonomy in Responsibility: Fulfilling duties from a place of inner freedom rather than compulsion

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Yoga-sannyasta-karmanam (One who has surrendered work through yoga/detachment)
Jnana-chinna-samsayam (One whose doubts are completely severed by knowledge)
Na karmani nibadhnanti (Actions do not bind or entangle)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Rooted in the self and free of doubt, one who offers up action's fruits acts fully liberated from karmic obligation.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Clearing mental ambiguity and releasing outcome-obsession empowers fearless, highly effective action.
